entities.name: Johan Kjeldahl
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johan Gustav Christoffer Thorsager Kjeldahl, was a Danish chemist who developed a method for determining the amount of nitrogen in certain organic compounds using a laboratory technique which was named the Kjeldahl method after him.
